title: What if China blocked the Brahmaputra? Part 3: India's response 🏗️
description:
What if India answered China's mega dam with another dam?

The proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh is planned at around 11,200 megawatts and could store water and reduce flood risk. It is still at the study stage, and local Adi communities have protested, fearing villages and farmland could be submerged. A water story with no easy villain.

📌 Quick facts
• Siang Upper Multipurpose Project: proposed by NHPC, about 11,000 to 11,200 MW, survey and pre-feasibility stage (check the latest status)
• Adi communities in Upper Siang have protested over submergence
• India also needs a data-sharing agreement with China and a plan for floods and droughts downstream
• The dam position on the map is approximate
Figures are approximate and rounded.
